limitations: This is a new reconstructed synthetic candidate, not the previously lost candidate or a production build.
The old v1 writer is a raw IndexedDB fixture, not the exact archived +14 Flutter application.
Only disposable profiles, a synthetic database and synthetic water are tested; no real diary or account is accessed.
The injected abort is not real quota exhaustion, process termination, power loss or hardware failure.
A single synthetic JSON restore does not prove every type of record or real backup recovery.
An ordinary old v1 rollback is incompatible. Safari/iOS, Android, cloud sync and multiple devices are not covered.
